title: delete removes metadata and storage object
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / XSUAA / HANA Cloud / S3
testCommand: DonHV PM Fiori Edit/Delete/Save confirmation plus exact S3/HANA readback and post-fix active DELETE 405 acceptance
actualResult: DonHV confirmed the PM Fiori Edit → Delete → Save flow on BUG-0019 and History recorded Deleted attachment PlatformAPI.json. Exact backend readback removed the S3 object and HANA metadata while unrelated Bug state stayed unchanged. After release 19c2f8b0, direct active DELETE is rejected with HTTP 405.
assertions: Committed Fiori delete produced one readable deletion History event.
S3 object and HANA metadata were removed.
Unrelated Bug status, comments and notifications remained unchanged.
Direct active attachment DELETE now returns HTTP 405 and cannot bypass Save.
limitations: The original exact S3/HANA removal used a direct active DELETE and exposed the audit bypass; it is retained only as pre-fix technical evidence. Final user flow is Fiori draft Save, and release 19c2f8b0 blocks the old direct path with 405. HANA Cloud auto-stopped during the earlier readback, was restarted, and final readiness passed.
